clue.text: Students slip up on the way back

indicators.note: travelling on the way back means the phrase slip up is read from its end to its start

explanation.surface: A student trips while walking home.
explanation.definitionFit: Pupils are schoolchildren being taught, a synonym for students.

clue.text: Do, do something! Get leverage round it

indicators.note: round says the first phrase's synonym wraps about the act, the it of the clue

parts.note: to prise is to force open using leverage
to act is to do something

explanation.surface: An exasperated urging to take action, using a lever if need be.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'it' after 'round' refers back to the act just urged. Practise with an S is the British spelling of the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To practise a trade or profession is to do it, as one practises law.

clue.text: Tiptoe, cat style, and slip

indicators.note: style here is a manner or fashion to put the letters in, so the words before it are rearranged

explanation.surface: Moving on tiptoe like a cat and then losing one's footing.
explanation.definitionFit: A slip is a woman's undergarment, much the same as a petticoat.

clue.text: Slip it to get out of hair

definitions.text: Slip it to get out of hair

parts.words: Slip it to get out of hair
parts.note: one slips the bolt of a door's fastening to get out, and the same word is a tress of hair

explanation.surface: Advice on escaping from someone's hair.
explanation.definitionFit: A bolt or catch on a door is slipped to escape, and a tress or curl of hair carries the same name.

clue.text: Slip of a girl I get on with after love

indicators.note: after places the remaining pieces behind the letter for love

parts.note: love is nil in tennis, the letter O
Miss is the title of an unmarried girl
taken as written

explanation.surface: A girl getting along with someone after falling in love.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Slip of a girl' looks like one phrase meaning a young girl, but Slip alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: An omission is a thing left out by mistake, a lapse or oversight.

clue.text: Slip road with wooden post

parts.note: the M1 is Britain's main north-south motorway, often written MI in crosswords
a stake is a pointed wooden post

explanation.surface: A slip road onto a highway marked with a wooden post.
explanation.definitionFit: A mistake is an error, as is a slip.

clue.text: Accompaniment to film runners can trust?

definitions.meaning: the recorded music and sound played along with a movie
read whimsically, a running track that is sound, in good condition, is one athletes can rely on

explanation.definitionFit: A film's music recording accompanies the pictures; a reliable running circuit is a dependable track.

clue.text: Further on in the mainframe

indicators.note: in says the answer sits inside the letters of the words that follow

explanation.surface: A remark about something deeper in a computer's mainframe.
explanation.definitionFit: Infra is Latin for below, used in texts to mean later or further on.

clue.text: Talk to Jack the toad

definitions.meaning: this word placed before Jack names the natterjack, a European toad

explanation.walkthrough: The natterjack is a toad found in Britain; the second definition is the word that joins Jack to make it.
explanation.definitionFit: To chatter idly is to talk, and the word prefixes Jack in a toad's name.

clue.text: Slip into programming or news

indicators.note: programming arranges code, here the letters of or news, into a new order

explanation.surface: A clumsy mistake creeping into a schedule of shows or a bulletin.
explanation.walkthrough: Slip is a verb here: to get worse, decline.
explanation.definitionFit: To worsen is to decline in quality, to slip back.

clue.text: Dictator abandoned by deserter Diana at motor event

indicators.note: abandoned by says the deserter's synonym leaves the dictator's synonym

parts.note: an autocrat is an absolute ruler
a rat is one who deserts, as rats leave a sinking ship
Diana Ross, the American singer

explanation.surface: A tyrant forsaken by a turncoat named Diana at a car race.
explanation.walkthrough: AUTOCRAT without RAT leaves AUTOC; then add ROSS.
explanation.definitionFit: Autocross is a form of motor racing on a grass or dirt course, so a motor sports meeting.

clue.text: Fun sport — it isn't good enough

definitions.note: the definition is a verb phrase; the answer is the adjective, as in 'is unfit'

indicators.note: sport as a verb means to play about, so the letters of Fun are jumbled

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A complaint that a fun game is not up to standard.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unfit falls short of the required standard, not being suitable.

clue.text: A slip of a thing?

indicators.note: a slip loses something, so the word thing lets one letter slip away, its final G

explanation.surface: Describing a slender young person.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue also reads straight: a slip of a thing is a slender person.
explanation.definitionFit: A slight, slender person is called a slip of a thing, meaning lean and slim.

clue.text: A people like us lives with a different calendar

parts.note: one who lives is, exists

indicators.note: different says the letters of calendar take another order

explanation.surface: A nation like ours living by another calendar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'different' turns CALENDAR into LANDRACE. The setter, writing for a British paper, means the British, who live on an island.
explanation.definitionFit: Island race is a traditional term for the British people as a nation of islanders.

clue.text: Parasitical growth in trunk is a hanging affair

indicators.note: in says the growth's synonym goes inside the trunk's synonym

parts.note: a main artery is a trunk line, as the main road or rail routes are arteries
a gall is a swelling on a plant caused by insects or parasites

explanation.surface: A tumour inside a tree's trunk gets itself hanged.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a hanging affair' suggests an execution; it means a place where pictures are hung.
explanation.definitionFit: A gallery exhibits paintings hung on its walls, so it is a place of hanging.

clue.text: Fun and games not finished, fled in front of Scotsman

indicators.note: not finished says the sport synonym loses its final letter

parts.note: sport means fun and games
ran means fled

explanation.surface: Someone running off ahead of a Scotsman after an unfinished game.
explanation.walkthrough: SPORT without its last letter gives SPOR.
explanation.definitionFit: A sporran is the pouch worn hanging over the front of a Highland kilt.

clue.text: Right in period, thanks to slips

indicators.note: in places the abbreviation for right inside the period's synonym

parts.note: an era is a period of history
ta is British informal for thanks

explanation.surface: Being correct at a given time, owing to some errors.
explanation.definitionFit: Errata are listed printing errors, mistakes or slips in a text.

clue.text: Violent people that are hard-boiled?

parts.note: hard-boiled describes tough, ruthless people as well as eggs cooked solid

explanation.surface: Asking whether thugs are callous.
explanation.definitionFit: Hard-boiled describes eggs cooked solid and also callous, tough people, so ruffians are called this.

clue.text: Slips cut by ladies?

parts.note: to slit is to cut
something belonging to a woman is hers

explanation.surface: Lingerie trimmed by women.
explanation.walkthrough: Slips looks like the plural noun; it is a verb, moves smoothly.
explanation.definitionFit: To slither is to slide or slip along.

clue.text: Coaching stops at very good times

parts.note: a very good person is a saint, abbreviated ST
ages are long periods of time

explanation.surface: A sports trainer pausing at excellent moments.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Coaching' suggests training; it is about stagecoaches.
explanation.definitionFit: A stagecoach changed horses at points along its route, each a stop.

clue.text: Doctor Thorne's cut

indicators.note: to doctor is to alter, so the letters of Thorne's are rearranged

explanation.surface: A trim given to Anthony Trollope's novel Doctor Thorne.
explanation.walkthrough: Doctor Thorne is a Trollope novel, but Doctor is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: To shorten something is to cut it down.

clue.text: Model, genuine, affected by touch

parts.note: the Model T was Ford's famous early car
actual means real, genuine

explanation.surface: A real model sensitive to touch.
explanation.definitionFit: Tactual means relating to the sense of feel, tactile.

clue.text: Physical exercise in former days may give you the slip

indicators.note: in places the exercise abbreviation inside the past-time synonym

parts.note: then refers to a time in the past
PE is physical education, school exercise

explanation.surface: Gym lessons of yesteryear could help one escape.
explanation.walkthrough: A slip of the pen is a writing error, so the pen gives you one.
explanation.definitionFit: A writing instrument causes a slip in writing a word wrongly.

clue.text: Hat, if fast, needs slips

definitions.meaning: a hard round felt hat, the derby
in cricket a fast deliverer of the ball sets fielders in the slips, catching positions behind the batsman

explanation.definitionFit: A derby is a kind of hat, and in cricket a pace thrower needs slip fielders.

clue.text: Seen from above and not done

definitions.meaning: looked down upon from a height

explanation.definitionFit: A view from higher ground looks down on a place; a neglected task was missed.

clue.text: Dispense with rising American general keeping his shop

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising means the letters are read upwards, back to front
keeping says the general's name holds the shop inside it

parts.note: Robert E Lee, the Confederate general
a PX, post exchange, is a US Army shop

explanation.surface: An American general's shop going up and being got rid of.
explanation.walkthrough: 'keeping' puts PX in LEE for LEPXE; 'rising' turns it to read upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: To expel someone is to throw them out, getting rid of them.

clue.text: A slip of a girl?

parts.note: a slip of paper such as a bill is one sense, and a pert young girl is another

explanation.surface: Describing a slight young girl.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a short note or voucher, a slip of paper, and a pert young girl.

clue.text: Entrance the same with gold

parts.note: do is short for ditto, meaning the same
or is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: A gilded and identical way in.
explanation.walkthrough: Entrance is a noun, not the verb to enchant.
explanation.definitionFit: A door is a way into a building, an entrance.

clue.text: Slip of northern folk recorded

indicators.note: recorded points to the words being spoken onto tape, so the answer sounds like them

parts.note: the Lapps are a people of northern Scandinavia

explanation.surface: An error made by people from the far north.
explanation.definitionFit: A lapse is a slight error or failure.

clue.text: Thursday school has some guests that may give you the slip

parts.note: Eton is the English public school

indicators.note: some takes just part of the word guests, its opening run

explanation.surface: Guests at a school on a Thursday who might escape.
explanation.walkthrough: A slip of the tongue is a spoken error, so the tongue gives you one.
explanation.definitionFit: The mouth's speaking organ causes the verbal slip of saying the wrong word.

clue.text: Comrade in boxing scene has a cry

definitions.note: the answer is the word that comes with cry in a rallying cry

indicators.note: in places the comrade's synonym inside the boxing arena's

parts.note: boxers fight in a ring
an ally is a comrade

explanation.surface: A friend in the boxing ring calling out.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is cryptic: the answer has a cry, it forms the phrase rallying cry, a call to unite.
explanation.definitionFit: A rallying cry is a slogan to gather support, so this word is paired with a call.

clue.text: Cry starting off to goddess at time of emergency

indicators.note: starting off keeps just the start of the word Cry, its last letter left off

parts.note: Isis was an Egyptian goddess

explanation.surface: Sobbing off towards a goddess in a moment of danger.
explanation.definitionFit: A crisis is a moment of intense difficulty or danger, an emergency.
